Veterans Benefits: Nevada has no state individual income tax, so military retirement pay, VA disability, and Social Security are all state-tax-free. Disabled veterans with a service-connected rating of 60% or more receive a property-tax exemption that scales with the rating, filed with the county assessor.

Description: Fallon is a small high-desert farming town in Nevada's Lahontan Valley, home to Naval Air Station Fallon and the Naval Aviation Warfighting Development Center (TOPGUN). It offers a low crime rate, an in-city VA outpatient clinic, and Nevada's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement, in a dry, sunny climate. Tradeoffs include a remote location (~60 mi east of Reno), high gas prices, and no local Costco.
